CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_cerrado()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_claims()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select case when coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true), '') = '' then null
              else current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_empleado_ok(p_jefe boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from datos d, jsonb_array_elements(case when jsonb_typeof(d.valor) = 'array' then d.valor else '[]'::jsonb end) e
    where d.clave = 'empleados'
      and e->>'id' = (hg_claims()->'app_metadata'->>'emp_id')
      and (not p_jefe or e->>'puesto' = 'Jefe')
  )
$function$
functions.name: hg_empleado_ok

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_es_jefe()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select hg_claims() is null or not hg_cerrado() or hg_empleado_ok(true)
$function$
functions.name: hg_es_jefe

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_permitido()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_reservadas(p_producto text, p_excluir text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(sum((it->>'qty')::integer), 0)::integer
  from datos d, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(d.valor->'items', '[]'::jsonb)) it
  where d.clave like 'encargo:%'
    and d.clave <> 'encargo:' || coalesce(p_excluir, '')
    and coalesce((d.valor->>'deleted')::boolean, false) = false
    and coalesce((d.valor->>'finished')::boolean, false) = false
    and coalesce((d.valor->>'cancelled')::boolean, false) = false
    and d.valor->>'fab' = 'FABRICADO'
    and coalesce((d.valor->>'depositCents')::numeric, 0) > 0
    and it->>'name' = p_producto
$function$
functions.name: hg_reservadas
hg_solo_adicion

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hg_venta_material(n text, producto boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select case when producto or n = 'Pólvora' then n else 'mat:' || case
 translate(lower(trim(regexp_replace(n, '\s+', ' ', 'g'))),'áéíóúñ','aeioun')
 when 'tornillo' then 'Tornillo' when 'tornillos' then 'Tornillo'
 when 'pieza de arma' then 'Pieza de arma' when 'pieza de armas' then 'Pieza de arma'
 when 'piezas de arma' then 'Pieza de arma' when 'piezas de armas' then 'Pieza de arma'
 when 'canon de revolver' then 'Cañón de revólver' when 'canones de revolver' then 'Cañón de revólver'
 when 'canones de revolveres' then 'Cañón de revólver' when 'canon de revolveres' then 'Cañón de revólver'
 when 'culata de revolver' then 'Culata de revólver' when 'culatas de revolver' then 'Culata de revólver'
 when 'culatas de revolveres' then 'Culata de revólver' when 'culata de revolveres' then 'Culata de revólver'
 when 'mena de hierro' then 'Hierro' when 'menas de hierro' then 'Hierro'
 when 'mena de carbon' then 'Carbón' when 'menas de carbon' then 'Carbón'
 when 'tablones' then 'Tabla de madera' when 'tablon' then 'Tabla de madera'
 when 'tablas de madera' then 'Tabla de madera'
 when 'trozo madera' then 'Trozo de madera' when 'trozos de madera' then 'Trozo de madera'
 else trim(regexp_replace(n, '\s+', ' ', 'g')) end end
$function$
functions.name: hg_venta_material

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ver_copia(p_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'tipo', tipo, 'creada', creada, 'datos', datos, 'stock', stock, 'contador', contador)
  from copias where id = p_id and hg_permitido()
$function$

triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER hg_solo_adicion BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.datos FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.clave ~~ 'act:%'::text) OR (old.clave ~~ 'recu:%'::text) OR (old.clave ~~ 'npcrev:%'::text) OR (old.clave ~~ 'fablote:%'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION hg_solo_adicion()
